context: 2026-10-04 closeout: Delivered in #2605: DataFrame implementations of 14b, 23b, 24b and 39b; 103 statements gated.
description: Production TPC-DS power runs include the variant queries 14b, 23b and 39b (the second statement of templates 14, 23 and 39). The DataFrame side has no implementation for them and, with variant fallback on by default, silently runs the base implementation (the first statement). So the DataFrame result is a different query from the SQL it is compared with. Found by the t07 end-to-end check (evidence/rev3/t07/compare.txt). The cross-surface gate does not see this, because BenchBox's gate SQL is only the first statement.
